_meta.purpose: Blind human labels on the judge's single binary criterion (CORRECT/INCORRECT = is the answer faithful to the contracts AND does it answer the question). Hand-labeled by reading traces/legal_traces.jsonl ONLY, before any LLM judge was run. Commit order proves this file predates the judge run.
_meta.criterion: CORRECT if the answer states what the contracts say and answers the question (a refusal is CORRECT only when the answer is genuinely absent); otherwise INCORRECT.
